description: React demo UI for ACIP (self-contained top-level ui/, Vite + TypeScript + React 18) as a THIN presentation layer over the EXISTING checkout-api, plus the single backend change it requires (additive CORSMiddleware on checkout-api) and its Dockerization (multi-stage ui/Dockerfile -> nginx) wired into docker-compose as demo-ui on new host port 8090:80, and Docker-mode doc/summary updates. This is the whole UI deliverable and is self-verifiable end-to-end (backend static gate + frontend gate + docker compose config/build). Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002's start-local.sh references the Vite dev server this feature creates; FEAT-001 therefore comes first.
steps: Add CORSMiddleware to services/checkout-api/src/checkout_api/main.py: read allowed origins from env CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS (comma-separated, default '*'), add app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=..., allow_methods=['*'], allow_headers=['*']). Keep it additive — must not change decision behavior. Add a test (in services/checkout-api/tests/test_checkout.py or new tests/test_cors.py) asserting an access-control-allow-origin header is present (send an Origin header on a GET, or OPTIONS preflight to /v1/checkout). Run `uv run pytest services/checkout-api` and confirm the prior tests + the new CORS test pass.

Scaffold ui/ as a self-contained Node project (NOT a uv member): ui/package.json with PINNED deps (react@18.3.1, react-dom@18.3.1, vite@5.4.10, @vitejs/plugin-react@4.3.3, typescript@5.6.3, vitest@2.1.5, @testing-library/react@16.0.1, @testing-library/jest-dom@6.6.3, @testing-library/user-event@14.5.2, jsdom@25.0.1, eslint@9.14.0, @typescript-eslint/parser@8.14.0, @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin@8.14.0, eslint-plugin-react-hooks@5.0.0, eslint-plugin-react-refresh@0.4.14, prettier@3.3.3, @types/react@18.3.12, @types/react-dom@18.3.1, @types/node@20.17.6; scripts dev='vite', build='tsc -b && vite build', preview='vite preview', lint='eslint .', test='vitest run'), ui/tsconfig.json, ui/tsconfig.node.json, ui/vite.config.ts (React plugin; dev server port 5173; vitest config environment 'jsdom' + setupFiles ui/vitest.setup.ts), ui/.eslintrc.cjs (or eslint.config.js), ui/.prettierrc, ui/index.html, ui/vitest.setup.ts (import @testing-library/jest-dom), ui/.gitignore (node_modules, dist), ui/README.md (dev/build/test instructions + the DECISION that Docker uses build-time VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL). Generate ui/package-lock.json via npm install and COMMIT it. If a pinned version is unavailable, use the nearest stable patch of the same minor and note it in findings.

Implement the thin API layer: ui/src/api/types.ts (TS interfaces mirroring the three checkout-api shapes: CheckoutResponse {transaction_id, decision, route, composite_score, explanation, recommended_method, partial, degraded_agents, route_alternatives, verdicts, trace_id}; TransactionView {transaction_id, customer_id, amount, status, decision, composite_score, strategy, verdicts: AgentVerdict[], created_at}; ExplainView {transaction_id, inputs, verdicts: AgentVerdict[], strategy, final_decision}; AgentVerdict {agent, score, hint}) and ui/src/api/client.ts (postCheckout(body), getTransaction(id), getExplain(id), pollTransaction(id, attempts, delayMs) that refetches until verdicts non-empty or attempts exhausted and tolerates 404). Base URL from import.meta.env.VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL default 'http://localhost:8080'. HTTP only, NO decision logic.

Implement ui/src/scenarios.ts (the five scenario POST bodies EXACTLY mirroring scripts/demo.py + scripts/seed.py: merchant_id='mrc_demo', currency='INR', context.device_fingerprint=<device_id>, context.ip='203.0.113.9', context.user_agent='acip-demo/1.0', idempotency_key='idem_demo_<name>' (optionally with a nonce suffix to allow re-runs), payment_method.token='tok_<name>'; the five: clean_shopper/cus_clean/120.0/upi/dev_clean/APPROVE, ring_member/cus_ring/90.0/card/dev_shared/DECLINE, high_value_midrisk/cus_midrisk/4800.0/card/dev_midrisk/CHALLENGE, sanctioned_geo/cus_sanctioned/200.0/wallet/dev_sanctioned/DECLINE, unhealthy_preferred_route/cus_reroute/260.0/card/dev_reroute/APPROVE) and ui/src/decision.ts (decisionColor(decision) -> 'approve'|'challenge'|'decline'; APPROVE green, CHALLENGE amber, DECLINE red; null/unknown handled gracefully).

Build the React components + app shell + hand-rolled CSS: ui/src/main.tsx (root), ui/src/App.tsx (state for current decision, polled transaction, recent-transactions session list, loading/error; orchestrates POST->poll), ui/src/components/ScenarioButtons.tsx, CheckoutForm.tsx (merchant, customer, amount, currency, payment method type, device fingerprint), DecisionBanner.tsx (prominent colored banner with decision, composite_score, route + alternatives, recommended_method, explanation), AgentCards.tsx (six verdict cards from the polled transaction: agent, score, hint; tolerate empty/partial with a 'waiting for agents' state), RecentTransactions.tsx (session list with click-through), ExplainView.tsx (renders the /explain trace), ui/src/styles.css. Include explicit loading + error states (checkout-api unreachable -> clear message).

Add Vitest + React Testing Library tests under ui/src/__tests__/ (HTTP mocked, no live API): banner color/decision mapping for APPROVE/DECLINE/CHALLENGE; AgentCards rendering for a POPULATED verdicts list AND an EMPTY list (no crash, shows waiting state); scenario-button payloads match the canonical bodies; client/App error state when fetch rejects. Run `cd ui && npm run test` (vitest run) and confirm all pass; run `npm run lint` and `npm run build`.

Add the multi-stage ui/Dockerfile: stage 1 node:20-alpine runs `npm ci && npm run build` with ARG VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL (default http://localhost:8080) exported to the build env; stage 2 nginx:alpine copies dist/ to the web root with a custom ui/nginx.conf (SPA history fallback try_files $uri /index.html; listen 80). Add ui/.dockerignore (node_modules, dist). Build-time VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL is the chosen config approach (documented in ui/README.md).

Wire demo-ui into deploy/docker-compose.yml ADDITIVELY (do not touch other service blocks): service demo-ui with build {context: .., dockerfile: ui/Dockerfile, args: {VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL: 'http://localhost:8080'}}, container_name acip-demo-ui, depends_on {checkout-api: {condition: service_started}}, networks [acip-net], ports ['8090:80']. Run `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml config` and confirm valid + demo-ui listed at 8090:80.

Surface the Demo UI in start.sh printed summary (add http://localhost:8090 as the primary URL; summary heredoc is the ONLY start.sh edit — behavior otherwise byte-identical) and add a short 'Demo UI (React)' section to docs/DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md and the UI URL to README.md quickstart. Do NOT modify docs/01-07.

Stage only source files and commit locally on feat/phase1-foundation with a short -m one-liner (e.g. 'feat(ui): react demo UI + checkout-api CORS + compose demo-ui'). Do NOT commit ui/node_modules, ui/dist, .env, or .agents bookkeeping (gitignore entries are added in FEAT-002; until then stage ui/ files explicitly by path). Never push. Record in findings any pinned-version substitutions and whether the frontend gate ran on host Node or via the Docker build.
acceptance_criteria: `uv run pytest services/checkout-api` passes including a new test asserting an access-control-allow-origin header is present on a checkout-api response.
CORSMiddleware is the ONLY backend code change; decision behavior is unchanged (all prior checkout-api tests still pass).
ui/ is self-contained with pinned deps and a committed ui/package-lock.json, and is NOT referenced in root pyproject.toml.

`cd ui && npm run build` produces ui/dist/index.html; `npm run lint` passes; `npm run test` (vitest run) passes, including tests for banner color mapping (APPROVE/CHALLENGE/DECLINE), AgentCards with populated AND empty verdicts, and scenario-button payloads.
The UI fetches per-agent verdicts via GET /v1/transactions/{id} (polling, tolerating empty/partial) rather than expecting them in the POST response.
`docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml config` is valid and lists demo-ui at 8090:80; a git diff of the compose file shows only the added demo-ui block.

ui/Dockerfile builds (node:20-alpine npm ci && npm run build -> nginx:alpine on port 80 with SPA fallback); start.sh summary, README.md, and docs/DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md reference http://localhost:8090; docs/01-07 unchanged.

findings: DONE. Frontend gate ran on HOST Node 20 (installed via `brew install node@20`; binaries at /opt/homebrew/opt/node@20/bin, node v20.20.2 / npm 10.8.2 — add that prefix to PATH to re-run). `npm install` (generating + committing ui/package-lock.json), `npm run build` (-> ui/dist/index.html), `npm run lint` (clean), and `npm run test` (vitest, 24 tests across 6 files) ALL PASS on host; additionally `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml build demo-ui` succeeds end-to-end (npm ci + npm run build in node:20-alpine -> nginx:alpine), so the Docker path is also verified. No pinned-version substitutions were needed — every version in FEAT-001 step 2 resolved as pinned. Backend: `uv run pytest services/checkout-api` = 16 passed (14 prior + 2 new CORS tests: header-present on GET + OPTIONS preflight on /v1/checkout). CORS reads env CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS (comma-separated, default '*'); additive only, decision behavior unchanged. demo-ui compose service: host port EXACTLY 8090:80 (container listens on 80), build context repo-root with dockerfile ui/Dockerfile and build-arg VITE_CHECKOUT_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 (build-time config, documented in ui/README.md). `docker compose config` valid; git diff of deploy/docker-compose.yml is +19/-0 (only the demo-ui block). start.sh edit is summary-heredoc only (adds Demo UI http://localhost:8090 as primary URL); `bash -n start.sh` ok and grep 8090 ok. Docs: only docs/DEMO-WALKTHROUGH.md + README.md updated; docs/01-07 untouched. ESLint uses a flat eslint.config.js (ESLint 9) kept dependency-light (no @eslint/js). ui/ NOT added to root pyproject.toml. Committed on feat/phase1-foundation; ui/node_modules + ui/dist NOT committed (ui/.gitignore). NOTE for FEAT-002: repo-root .gitignore still lacks entries for logs/ run/ ui/node_modules ui/dist .agents — those are FEAT-002's job; ui/ files were staged explicitly by path here.
